About The Role And Team
As a member of Uber's Offensive Security team, you will build the security tools, platforms, and AI-powered automation that enable security testing and risk reduction at Uber scale. You will develop software that automates and enhances security processes including security design reviews, threat modeling, penetration testing, vulnerability discovery and validation, and AI agent security testing. This role combines strong software engineering with an automation-first mindset, applying AI and frontier models to transform traditionally manual security processes into continuous, scalable capabilities integrated across Uber's technology ecosystem.
The problems here are messy and the systems are global. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end-to-end, and stay calm when high-load systems are on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring, and believe that the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross-functional collaboration. If you're energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world - this is where you'll grow.
What You'll Do
Build software platforms and automation across static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), penetration testing, AI red teaming, security design reviews, and threat modeling.
Develop AI-powered agents and workflows that analyze source code and technical designs, orchestrate security assessments, generate test cases, and validate findings.
Partner with security engineers to translate their expertise into repeatable, scalable capabilities.
Build and scale foundational infrastructure and data pipelines, balancing technical debt and shifting priorities while keeping long-term impact in mind.
Integrate security capabilities with source control, CI/CD pipelines, service inventories, and issue-tracking systems to enable continuous and on-demand testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
Build shared services for assessment orchestration, findings normalization and deduplication, and remediation tracking, reducing duplicate findings and manual work for security and engineering teams.
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality code for features of moderate complexity and projects with multiple dependencies.
Develop evaluation frameworks and operational safeguards for AI-driven security workflows, measuring accuracy, coverage, latency, and cost while enforcing appropriate access controls, execution boundaries, and auditability.
Own the software lifecycle end-to-end, from drafting design docs to debugging production issues and managing incidents independently.
Collaborate across disciplines - including Product, Data Science, and Ops - to translate ambiguous requirements into simple, elegant system designs.
Champion engineering best practices by providing quality code reviews, creating comprehensive tests, and improving system performance.
Navigate internal complexity and stakeholder inquiries to unblock dependencies and ensure the reliability of our production environment.
Basic Qualifications
3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering.
Proficiency in one or more object-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C++).
Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design.
Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability.
Experience building APIs, service integrations, or automated workflows that connect multiple systems in production environments.
Understanding of secure software development fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and safe handling of credentials.
Familiarity with source control, CI/CD, and automated testing practices for delivering reliable software.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building agentic security workflows that autonomously gather technical context, reason across multiple data sources, invoke security tools, validate conclusions, and produce evidence-backed security assessments.
Experience applying frontier LLMs to complex security reasoning, including architecture analysis, attack-path identification, threat enumeration, vulnerability discovery, and security control validation.
Experience developing multi-agent or multi-model architectures that use specialized agents, model routing, or model-as-judge techniques to improve the accuracy, coverage, and confidence of automated security reviews.
Experience identifying and reducing code-level technical debt in high-load distributed systems.
Background in mentoring new team members and contributing to engineering culture.
Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka).
Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering trade-offs for complex systems.
Experience building security tools or automation in one or more of the following domains: SAST, DAST, SCA, penetration testing, AI red teaming, security design reviews, or threat modeling.
Experience developing LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows, including model integration, tool execution, context retrieval, and orchestration.
Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI-driven systems, including reproducible benchmarks, regression testing, and measurement of output quality and reliability.
Familiarity with source-code analysis, dependency graphs, API testing, or isolated execution environments for automated security testing.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software implementation, testing, debugging, and maintenance.

TikTok's commitment to technological innovation, user-centric design, and diverse content offerings positions it at the forefront of the digital entertainment industry. As part of its ongoing growth and commitment to excellence, TikTok continually invests in cutting-edge research and development to enhance user experience and platform capabilities.
About The Role
We are seeking talented and motivated individuals to join our Recommendation Algorithm team as interns for Fall 2025. This internship provides a unique opportunity to gain industry exposure and hands-on experience in developing advanced machine learning models that drive the core functionalities of TikTok's platform. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced researchers and engineers, contributing to the development and optimization of recommendation systems that shape user engagement and content distribution. You will be involved in end-to-end project cycles, from data analysis and model development to deployment and performance evaluation. This role is ideal for students passionate about machine learning, data science, and building scalable solutions that impact millions of users worldwide.

Relevant coursework or experience in recommendation systems, natural language processing, deep learning, or large language models is highly desirable. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset are important. Candidates should be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. program, with a keen interest in applying theoretical knowledge to real-world challenges in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities include supporting the development and enhancement of TikTok's recommendation algorithms to improve content relevance and user experience. You will participate in designing, training, and deploying machine learning models that address key challenges such as content understanding, robustness, fairness, and scalability. Your role will involve analyzing large datasets to identify patterns and insights, experimenting with new modeling techniques, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate solutions into the platform. You will also be encouraged to innovate and propose new approaches to improve recommendation quality and platform safety, aligning with TikTok's mission to foster a positive and engaging environment for users worldwide.

We are seeking a highly motivated LiDAR Test & Calibration Engineer to develop, optimize, and support manufacturing test and calibration processes for LiDAR sensors in a high-volume production environment. Assist product engineers and business development teams with RMA support by investigating returned units

WHY DEPT®?
We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.
We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.
At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.
What We Believe In
We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:
Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.
The role
As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.
You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.
This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.
What You'll Do
Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.
What You Bring
Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.
Bonus points
Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
Exposure to agent development frameworks.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

AI in healthcare has made tremendous progress, but much of it remains focused on documentation, workflows, and cloud-based applications. We're building a different kind of platform.

We're moving quickly toward a production-ready platform and are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex problems across data, AI, and software systems.
This is not a role for a narrow specialist.

Most importantly, we're looking for builders. Engineers who are writing code, solving problems, and shipping systems today.
Preferred Technical Background
Agentic AI & Production AI Systems |
Experience building and deploying production-quality AI agents as a core responsibility of your role. This includes agent orchestration, retrieval workflows, evaluation frameworks, observability, guardrails, traceability, explainability, and lifecycle management in production environments.
Data Architecture & Retrieval Systems |
Designing systems that organize, retrieve, and present data for AI applications. Experience creating architectures that allow AI systems and agents to reliably consume complex datasets.
Data Ingestion & Integration |
Building and maintaining data pipelines that bring together multiple structured and unstructured data sources while ensuring reliability, scalability, and architectural consistency.
Healthcare, Wearable & Time-Series Data |
Experience working with healthcare-related data, wearable technology, sensor data, patient-generated data, clinical records, laboratory data, or other regulated datasets. Particularly valuable are engineers who have worked across multiple healthcare data types rather than a single domain.
Distributed Systems & Platform Engineering |
Experience building scalable backend systems, APIs, orchestration frameworks, and production infrastructure that support complex software and AI applications.
Software Product Development |
A history of delivering production-quality software while owning significant technical initiatives from concept through deployment.

Strong software engineering fundamentals and systems thinking
Experience building, owning, and operating production software systems
Demonstrated history of shipping production AI capabilities beyond research, experimentation, or side projects
Experience evaluating technical tradeoffs while remaining highly involved in implementation
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Strong sense of ownership and accountability
Experience working effectively with limited infrastructure, process, or organizational support
Evidence of direct individual contribution rather than primarily management, coordination, or architectural oversight
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements
Candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area are strongly preferred and should be willing to work a hybrid schedule
Who Will Thrive Here
Successful candidates are builders first. They are currently spending the majority of their time designing, building, coding, debugging, and shipping software. They understand how data flows through systems, how AI applications consume that data, and how to translate complex technical challenges into working software.

Opportunity to build foundational technology during a critical stage of company growth

What You Will Be Doing
Assist various network and AI cluster support teams in reproducing, resolving, and root causing sophisticated customer issues
Work with R&D teams to develop bug fixes, workarounds, and solutions for critical customers using NVIDIA’s network technologies
Become an authority in NVIDIA network technologies used in AI clusters such as Infiniband, NVLink, and Spectrum-X
Analyze network performance metrics and make tuning recommendations for high-performance, lossless networks
Develop support and analysis tools to help analyze and root cause field issues
Daily use of ground breaking AI tools for software development, log and trace analysis, and source code debugging
Occasional work on weekends or holidays to support customers
What We Need To See
Minimum of a BS in Computer, Electrical, or Software Engineering (or equivalent experience)
5+ years of experience in C or Python development on Linux platforms
8+ years of experience developing, testing, and debugging software for one or more of the following: Linux NIC drivers, switch ASICs and SDKs, embedded network device firmware, Linux based network equipment (routers, switches, gateways, etc), network operating systems, virtual routers, SDN stacks, virtual switching, DPDK, SRIOV stacks
At least 3 years of experience directly supporting end-customers, partners, or integrators for network equipment and infrastructures
Strong system software (firmware, BIOS, kernel, driver, operating system) expertise
Professional-level communication skills, including adjusting communication to the technical level of the audience, and staying calm and focused in negative situations.
Passion for learning innovative tech and motivation to work hard on ground-breaking products
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd
Experience developing drivers or firmeware for switch and NIC ASICs
Background with AI infrastructure and HPC networking
Experience with Infiniband or other non-Ethernet network technologies
Experience developing or supporting DPUs or SmartNICs
Knowledge of HPC performance test tools and NVIDIA AI stacks (NCCL, MPI, DOCA, CUDA)

Job Title:  Software Engineering Intern
Job Code:  40755
Job Location:  Rochester, NY
Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off
Job Description:
Apply computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis concepts and principles in the development of software for the target application
Work closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system

Develop software test procedures, software programs, and related documentation
Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results
Participate in peer reviews, identify, track and repair defects
Utilize a variety of software languages (i.e., C++, C#, C, Java, Ruby, HTML5, XML, SQL, Perl, Python, Ajax, Qt) on Windows, Linux, mobile platforms, and embedded real time operating systems (VxWorks, Linux, QNX, Integrity, Windows CE, and others for Motorola, Intel, TI, and custom processor designs)
Qualifications:
Must be pursuing a Bachelor’s degree, a Master’s degree, or a PhD in computer science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Wireless Engineering, Information Security, Mathematics, Digital Arts & Sciences or related field at an accredited university.

One or more of the following:  C++, C#, C, Java, Ruby, JEE, HTML5, XML, SQL, Qt, Windows, .NET, Unix, Linux, SOA, RTOS, Real-Time Controls, Wireless, Software Security, Robotics, OOA/OOD, Hadoop, Android, Embedded Systems

title: Summer 2027 - Electrical Engineering Internship, FPGA
reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
reject_reason: No visa sponsorship or requires citizenship/clearance
description_preview:
Please Note:
To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At
CesiumAstro
, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
The CesiumAstro FPGA team is looking for Summer 2027 interns to apply digital design and verification principles to FPGA’s for satellite communication systems.
FPGA interns will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers on FPGA’s through multiple phases of the development process. Interns will primarily focus on either FPGA design or FPGA verification, based on project needs, experience, and interests.
FPGA Design assignments may include developing and testing RTL for high-speed serial interfaces and data streams, digital processing cores, multiple clock domains, and management interfaces.
FPGA Verification assignments may include developing testbenches and verification environments, creating test scenarios, generating constrained-random stimulus, checking expected behavior, debugging failures, and measuring verification coverage.
Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates.
Prior FPGA-specific coursework or experience is not required. We recognize that access to FPGA courses, development boards, commercial tools, and verification environments varies among universities. We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in digital design or software-based verification concepts and an interest in applying those skills to FPGA development.
CesiumAstro interns regularly present their work to peers, mentors, and CesiumAstro executive leadership throughout the course of the summer. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.
To apply, please include a cover letter describing your interest in digital design, FPGA development or verification, and either space systems or communication systems, as well as your status as a US citizen or permanent resident.
Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications
Current enrollment in a Bachelor of Science (BS), Master of Science (MS), or PhD program in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering from an accredited university.
Understanding of fundamental digital design concepts, such as combinational and sequential logic, finite state machines, timing, and synchronous digital systems.
Digital design or hardware-description experience gained through coursework, research, personal projects, competition teams, internships, or other technical activities.
Demonstrated ability to approach technical problems methodically, learn new concepts, and debug complex systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Experience
FPGA development or verification experience through coursework, research, internships, personal projects, or extracurricular activities.
Experience with SystemVerilog, Verilog, VHDL, or UVM.
Experience with FPGA or HDL development tools such as AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Questa/ModelSim, or similar tools.
Experience in digital signal processing.
Experience with embedded systems or board-level digital hardware.
Coursework or experience in communication systems.
All CesiumAstro internships are compensated competitively and located onsite at one of our facilities.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Use SQL and other scripting languages to develop and maintain complex queries that pull and curate data from multiple sources

What You Will Do
Come join the best and brightest minds in the world at one of the most innovative and creative multidisciplinary research institutions engaged in strategic science on behalf of U.S national security. The work we do at Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) matters to our country and the world!!!
The Materials Synthesis and Integrated Devices (MPA-11) Group is seeking outstanding Post Bachelor student to join a multi-disciplinary team with on-going research efforts in fundamental and applied membrane materials development and engineering.
Active areas of research include: air separations, H2 production, water purification, and critical materials separations (including isotopic separations); translation of novel membrane/sorbent chemistries to industrially relevant platforms (e.g., hollow fibers and thin films); separation system process design and techno-economic analysis; and prototype system design and construction.
We engage in all aspects of materials development from macromolecule synthesis, materials formulation and characterization to materials translation into application specific platforms/shapes. The specific focus of this position is the development of polybenzimidazole and PBI-derived carbon molecule sieve hollow membranes with tailored gas transport characteristics. We utilize a broad variety of synthetic/formulation methods including wet chemistry, pyrolytic methods, fiber spinning and gas separation characterization. Materials interrogation and characterization is conducted utilizing the vast resources available at LANL.
